## Site identity
Education Activities (http://www.educationactivities.org/) is an online magazine-style blog publishing articles on education, careers, study, and related subjects. Its tagline-style quote says that education should aim at teaching values rather than mere facts.
![](images/Education-activity.png)

Current date shown: Thursday, June 17, 2021.

## Topic categories
Education, Financial Aid, Certification, Science, Languages, Skills Development, College and University, General, Online Education, Home Schooling.
Each category has its own listing at http://www.educationactivities.org/category/ followed by the lowercase hyphenated name (e.g. /category/financial-aid, /category/college-and-university, /category/skills-development, /category/online-education, /category/home-schooling).

## Site pages
- Home: http://www.educationactivities.org/
- Blog: http://www.educationactivities.org/blog
- About Us: http://www.educationactivities.org/about-us
- Privacy Policy: http://www.educationactivities.org/privacy-policy
- Contact us: http://www.educationactivities.org/contact-us
- Search function available.
- Browsing views for posts: Popular, Latest, and by Category.
- Quick links list: Home, About Us, Blog, Privacy Policy, Contact us.
- Top categories list: Education, Financial Aid, Certification, Science, Languages.
- Copyright notice (all rights reserved). Built on the "Daily Magazine" theme by AF themes (https://afthemes.com/products/daily-magazine, https://afthemes.com/).

## Author
James E. Turner, described as a business expert. All articles listed are credited to the account "WebEditor" (http://www.educationactivities.org/author/webeditor).
![](images/sexiest-men-over-george-clooney-imgcache-rev2954711158ccf2c86ae6587a973e7fd6-web.jpg)

content.text:
I built the site in the project folder. Open `index.html` to start. I haven't opened it in a browser, but the generator parsed all 31 articles from `brief.md` and wrote every page.

- **Home:** a hero with the featured articles, then a Latest / Popular / By Category switcher, plus an author card for James E. Turner.
- **Blog:** every article, with live search and a category filter. The search box in the top bar feeds into this page.
- **Category pages:** one for each of the 10 categories. Home Schooling, Financial Aid and Languages have no articles in the brief, so those pages show an empty message.
- **About Us, Privacy Policy and Contact us:** I only had the brief's one-line description of each, so About Us is short. The other two link to the live pages on educationactivities.org instead of inventing text.
- **Look:** a magazine-style layout with your logo, the education quote, today's date shown as June 17, 2021, and the footer with quick links, top categories and the AF themes credit. It works on phones and follows the system dark mode.

Article cards link out to the original educationactivities.org URLs, because the brief has no article body text. Articles without an image show a letter placeholder. The brief has no popularity data, so "Popular" shows the featured articles.

I kept the generator script at `/private/tmp/claude-501/s/gen.py`, so I can rebuild the pages if you change `brief.md`.
